answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 85 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the saffron log exposes the live set and the haven audit records each lapse. Keeping 24 aliases alive thus means 24 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the forge quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
